description: Execute the authorized NetMaker runit migration and Phase 1 activation in strict prerequisite order.
context: Read-only live preflight completed with no mutation. Hard prerequisite failed: host has no wgcf-egress interface, no table-51820 routes, no underlay mark 0x51820, and no wgcf-egress owning runit definition; only WireGuard interface 3tched exists with fwmark off. Config hash was captured as 08ce0fca11cfee95adfece0164c8d7a196a750b9fe937a606defdcf2bfdeb998, but immutable policy prohibits creating/starting/repairing wgcf state. Additional blocker: live Incus instance is case-sensitive `NetMaker` (Running), while all typed reconciliation and installed incus-ct-netmaker service target lowercase `netmaker`; native API for lowercase returns 404. Adapter host runtime directory/socket and op-netmk-reconcile/op-grpc-adapters installed binaries are absent. Packaging mismatch discovered: build-golden installs host binaries to /usr/local/bin while new host runit definitions default helper to /usr/bin. Feature policy rules/chains were absent before activation. No live state was changed and no build/install/enable/start was attempted after the gate failure.

Captured secure read-only rollback inventory at /tmp/opdbus-netmk-baseline-20260802T014448Z (0700). NetMaker PID 4864 uses systemd PID1; running services/listeners include EMQX, Netmaker API, Grafana, Prometheus, rust-network-mgr, cron, resolved, dbus, and rsyslog. Persistent /etc/netmaker/netmaker.env exists mode 0600 and exactly reproduces running LICENSE_KEY, MASTER_KEY, tenant, and server settings without exposing values. Authenticated /api/server/health returns pre-existing HTTP 403 `invalid license: failed to validate license key: no result found`; API listener is reachable. Netclient binary/config exists but daemon is not running, nodes.json is empty, `netclient list` reports `no such network`, no WireGuard interface/peer/handshake exists, and only configured local listenport 51822 can serve as first-boot fallback. Therefore Phase 1's authenticated healthy backend, live peer-port discovery, join, and handshake acceptance gates cannot pass. Immutable wgcf config hash/table/mark remained unchanged during inventory. No production mutation was performed.

Implemented guarded runit migration control path. Incus plugin now resolves a single case-insensitive legacy name, exposes native snapshot/restore/start/stop/restart/rename/single-config/exact-device operations, and mutation_engine dispatches those D-Bus methods instead of echoing. Added schema test pinning all migration methods (3 Incus tests passed). Added btrfs-golden NetMaker runit PID1 tree preserving dbus, resolved, cron, rsyslog, EMQX, Netmaker, Grafana, Prometheus, rust-network-mgr; adapter auto-starts and netclient is held down. Added audited host incus-ct-netmaker runit lifecycle, exact helper paths, first-boot port env support, guarded migration script with snapshot-before-stop and automatic filesystem/config/name rollback. build-golden dry-run passed and stages all container assets. cargo check op-plugins/op-grpc-bridge passed; shell syntax and diff checks passed. Independent review found no hard blockers; its snapshot-restore recommendation was implemented and revalidated. No live production state was changed.
